a.lede: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman acknowledged the special role Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has played in the AI boom, but ultimately thinks the industry will be “fine” without him at the helm.
a.title: Sam Altman on Nvidia without Jensen Huang: the industry will be ‘fine’

b.lede: Jensen Huang could be back in his old Nvidia office soon as allies rally to push the AI chipmaker to take him back just days after he was ousted over an affair with an alleged Chinese spy.
b.title: Jensen Huang could be plotting return as Nvidia CEO, report claims
